summary: BI-687E7D81 adds a private nullable S5 authorization ceiling to McpApiToken. No table, relation, backfill or credential activation is added by this migration.
affectedCopies: workroom_session_scoped rows carry exact room, attempt, Control receiver, binding, permit, coworker/job and optional qualification references, plus the maximum operation names.
The broker reads by the existing token hash only. The projection contains no bearer, provider secret, qualification record, prompt or post text.

privacyAssessment.sensitivity: Internal authorization references and allowlist for an AI coworker, kept on the existing user-owned credential row.
privacyAssessment.dataSubjectRights: No independent copy or change to existing user ownership, export or deletion.
privacyAssessment.reviewDisposition: Retain the existing credential audit lifecycle. Release revokes only matching scope and does not remove the audit row.

migration.name: 20261125143000_s5_room_credential_scope
migration.backfill: None. All existing rows stay null and are ineligible for S5 regardless of their grants.
migration.rollback: Disable scoped issuance and revoke affected scoped sessions. Revert the scoped reader and writer and retain the nullable column and audit rows. Do not restore broad credentials for these attempts.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Existing credential ownership and retention. The issued ceiling cannot grow and the absolute deadline never slides.

fields.reason: Binds the hash-only Control credential to the exact qualified attempt and limits admission to the operations originally issued.
